desc:
🚵 PROJECT MTB PARK [BETA]

Pick a downhill bike, drop in and send it! Land tricks, win races and earn money for faster bikes.

🏔️ ONE HUGE BIKE PARK
• Dirt Jumps, Pump Track, Big Air Line, North Shore, Wheelie Strip
• MEGA RAMP, Freeride Hill and the LAKE JUMP – clear the gap or you drown!
• Dirt and wooden kickers, teleport to every track

🔥 TRICKS
• Backflips (S in the air) – land it and get paid
• Whips (A / D), one hander, no hander
• Wheelies – hold too long and you loop out!
• Rolling stoppie (R + W) and drifts on the dirt

🏁 RACE
• Downhill race every few minutes – 30 checkpoints, faster = bigger prize

🚲 20 BIKES
• Each one different: frame, suspension, brakes
• Working suspension and disc brakes
• Your own race plate – name and number

🛠️ GARAGE
• Bars, grips, rims, tyres and paint
• Helmet, goggles and team kits

💰 Money for every second you ride, 10x and more in the air

🎥 First person (C)  📱 Phone, tablet and PC

BETA – more bikes, tricks and areas coming!
